```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert 'StichtagDat' to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a violin plot to visualize the distribution of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='KreisLang', y='AnzHunde', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Breeds by District')
plt.xlabel('District')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
